tldr_en: ROGUE-AI is a multi-agent framework that reconstructs reported LLM agent security incidents offline with matched controls, reproducing harm in 89% of 108 attempts and showing most harm stems from missed ordinary hazards rather than prompt injection, with causal hazard warnings reducing harm across five model families.
takeaways_en: ROGUE-AI replicated 89% of 108 reported agentic security incidents, enabling offline audit and root-cause attribution.
Across GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek agents, the blamed mistake occurred in 18–33% of runs versus ≤1% in controls lacking the blamed cause.
62 of 72 real-world harm incidents involved no attacker; agents followed task instructions but missed ordinary hazards like a shared production database.
No-attacker replications caused more harm than prompt injection replications across all five model families.
A tool-output warning that names the hazard and consequence reduced harm, while a same-length generic note did not.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because ROGUE-AI converts anecdotal AI accidents into a reproducible causal audit framework, enabling the systematic debugging and steering required for agents that act as reality-code manipulators.

translations.title_zh: 智能体安全事件复现：审计与调查（ROGUE-AI）
translations.tldr_zh: ROGUE-AI 是一个多智能体框架，通过离线重建已报告的 LLM 智能体安全事件并设置匹配对照，在 108 次尝试中复现了 89% 的伤害，显示大多数伤害源于遗漏普通危险而非提示注入，并且因果危险警告在五个模型系列中均降低了伤害。
takeaways_zh: ROGUE-AI 复现了 108 起已报告智能体安全事件中的 89%，实现了离线审计和根因归因。
在 GPT、Claude、Gemini 和 DeepSeek 智能体上，被归咎的错误在 18%–33% 的运行中出现，而在缺少该原因的对照组中不超过 1%。
72 起真实世界伤害事件中有 62 起没有攻击者；智能体遵循了任务指令，但遗漏了如共享生产数据库等普通危险。
在全部五个模型系列中，无攻击者复现比提示注入复现造成了更多伤害。
工具输出后能指出危险及其后果的警告降低了伤害，而同样长度但不提及危险的提示几乎无效。
translations.implication_zh: 实践者-哲学家应关注，因为 ROGUE-AI 将轶事般的 AI 事故转化为可复现的因果审计框架，实现了对作为现实代码操纵者的智能体所需的系统调试与引导。

tldr_en: IBM deployed a self-distilled memory pipeline for LLM agents, showing that the optimal amount of memory is model-dependent: strong models benefit from all learned guidelines while weaker models need a selected subset, with concrete failure modes and recommendations.
takeaways_en: The right amount of agent memory is a property of the model, not the memory itself.
Strong models like DeepSeek-V3.2 keep improving with more guidelines; weak models like gpt-oss-120b peak with a small selected subset (~29).
Self-distilled guidelines mined from agent trajectories ship in altk-evolve, CUGA, and watsonx Orchestrate.
Documented failure modes include high-support guidelines that backfire, provenance dropped during consolidation, and silently swallowed API errors.
Use AppWorld benchmarks and avoid baseline confounds when comparing memory methods.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers treating agents as reality-code manipulators, this paper provides empirical guidance on calibrating an agent's memory as a steering mechanism: too much or too little memory changes task outcomes, and the right setting depends on the model's competence, analogous to tuning cognitive load for an embedded executor.

translations.title_zh: 智能体应该记住多少？自蒸馏记忆用于LLM智能体的部署经验教训
translations.tldr_zh: IBM部署了一个自蒸馏记忆流水线用于LLM智能体，表明最佳记忆量取决于模型：强模型从所有学到的指南中获益，而弱模型需要精选子集，并给出了具体失败模式和建议。
takeaways_zh: 智能体记忆的合适数量是模型本身的属性，而非记忆本身。
强模型如DeepSeek-V3.2会随着指南增多而持续改进；弱模型如gpt-oss-120b在约29条精选子集时达到峰值。
从智能体轨迹中挖掘的自蒸馏指南已用于altk-evolve、CUGA和watsonx Orchestrate。
已记录的失败模式包括高支持度指南产生反效果、整合过程中来源丢失、API错误被静默吞掉。
比较记忆方法时应使用AppWorld基准并避免基线混淆。
translations.implication_zh: 对于将智能体视为现实代码操纵者的实践哲学家而言，本文提供了将智能体记忆作为转向机制进行校准的经验指导：记忆过多或过少都会改变任务结果，而正确设置取决于模型能力，类似于为嵌入式执行器调整认知负荷。

tldr_en: Clay's Head of AI explains how rebuilding their go-to-market agent around a coding harness, memory-first architecture, and user-journey evals delivered more value than post-training, including safer approvals on long bash commands and token-based pricing.
takeaways_en: Harness engineering outperformed post-training for improving agent capabilities.
Clay built memory (Knowledge Hub) before the agent, enabling grounded, context-aware actions.
They adopted an off-the-shelf harness rather than a custom lab-built one, reducing complexity.
Codex struggles at debugging long traces; Clay had to build custom tooling for observation and recovery.
Charging for tokens instead of outcomes better aligns pricing with actual agent usage and avoids overpromising.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because this shows that steering autonomous agents in commercial reality is a matter of engineering the surrounding harness, memory, and evaluation loops—not just model weights—making infrastructure the true 'reality-code' for agentic markets.

translations.title_zh: 深入 Clay 的 GTM 智能体重建
translations.tldr_zh: Clay 的 AI 负责人解释了他们如何围绕一个编码智能体框架、记忆优先架构和用户旅程评估重建 GTM 智能体，从而比后训练获得更多收益，包括对长 bash 命令的安全审批和按 token 定价。
takeaways_zh: 在提升智能体能力方面，框架工程比后训练带来了更多收益。
Clay 在构建智能体之前先构建了记忆（知识中心），使行动具备上下文基础。
他们采用了现成的框架而非实验室自建框架，降低了复杂性。
Codex 在调试长跟踪时表现很差，Clay 不得不构建自定义观测和恢复工具。
按 token 收费而不是按结果收费，能更好地使定价与实际的智能体使用对齐，避免过度承诺。
translations.implication_zh: 实践者-哲学家应关注，因为这表明在商业现实中操控自主智能体取决于对周围框架、记忆和评估循环的工程化，而不仅是模型权重——使基础设施成为智能体市场的真正‘现实代码’。

tldr_en: Formal verification systems using Lean and AI are emerging to mathematically prove the correctness of AI-generated code and agent outputs, shifting developers from vibe-coding to 'veri-coding'.
takeaways_en: Formal verification uses mathematical proofs (e.g., Lean) to guarantee code correctness, unlike testing which cannot prove all bugs are found.
Startups like &Truth, Harmonic, Theorem, and Axiom Math are building AI-assisted verification tools, with &Truth aiming to verify memory safety of all C code.
LLMs are making formal verification feasible at scale, with token efficiency improving (Anthropic Opus 5.5 used 40% fewer tokens).
Developer workflow shifts from reviewing code to writing precise specs, with agents collaborating with verification tools for 'veri-coding'.
Formal verification is also used in training math AI systems, where proof attempts improve future models.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because formal verification turns probabilistic AI output into machine-checked guarantees, potentially making autonomous agents trustworthy and aligning with the ideal of computable correctness—though it does not directly address the simulation hypothesis.

translations.title_zh: 对抗“低质输出”之战及新兴武器：形式化验证
translations.tldr_zh: 形式化验证系统利用 Lean 等数学证明和 AI，验证 AI 生成代码和智能体输出，推动开发者从氛围编程转向“验证编程”。
takeaways_zh: 形式化验证使用数学证明（如 Lean）来保证代码正确性，不像测试那样无法证明所有缺陷都被发现。
&Truth、Harmonic、Theorem 和 Axiom Math 等初创公司正在构建 AI 辅助验证工具，&Truth 的目标是验证所有 C 代码的内存安全。
LLM 正在使形式化验证大规模可行，令牌效率不断提升（Anthropic Opus 5.5 使用的令牌减少 40%）。
开发者工作流从审查代码转向编写精确规格，智能体与验证工具协作实现“验证编程”。
形式化验证也被用于训练数学 AI 系统，证明尝试有助于改进未来模型。
translations.implication_zh: 实践型哲学家应关注：形式化验证将 AI 输出从概率性垃圾转变为机器可检查的保证，可能使自主智能体值得信赖，并接近可计算正确性的理想（尽管并不直接涉及模拟假说）。

tldr_en: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 is an interactive world model that turns text prompts into real-time explorable environments, controllable via keyboard and live prompts, with a built-in agent for building custom apps and training robotics.
takeaways_en: Genie 4 generates dynamic, interactive worlds in real time from text prompts, not static video.
Users can navigate and direct scenes with keyboard controls and live prompts, enabling rapid prototyping.
Project Genie includes a built-in agent that maps custom apps to keyboard hotkeys for real-time character movement, dialogue, and events.
Prompts act as repeatable seeds for creative prototyping and robotics training environments.
Available now to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because Genie 4 operationalizes the idea of reality as a computable, steerable simulation, offering a concrete platform to test agent-world interaction and the boundaries of simulated environments.

translations.tldr_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 的 Genie 4 是一个交互式世界模型，可将文本提示实时转化为可探索的环境，可通过键盘和实时提示进行控制，并内置代理用于构建自定义应用和机器人训练。
takeaways_zh: Genie 4 从文本提示实时生成动态、可交互的世界，而非静态视频。
用户可以通过键盘控制和实时提示导航和指挥场景，实现快速原型制作。
Project Genie 内置了一个代理，可将自定义应用映射到键盘快捷键，实时触发角色移动、对话和事件。
提示词可作为可重复的种子，用于创意原型制作和机器人训练环境。
现已面向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者在 Project Genie 中提供。
translations.implication_zh: 实践哲学家应该关注，因为 Genie 4 将现实作为可计算、可操控的模拟这一理念具体化，提供了一个具体平台来测试代理与世界的交互以及模拟环境的边界。

tldr_en: This paper presents an LLM-agent system that autonomously proposes hypotheses and tunes cross-feature selections for fleet-scale ranking models under shared and per-model resource constraints, yielding measurable production metric gains.
takeaways_en: LLM agents can act as researchers/optimizers over combinatorial feature spaces with deterministic tools for experiment execution and verification.
Cost-aware feature selection via blending importance rankings and Pareto fronts across tasks works under QPS and pipeline cost budgets.
An LLM Researcher performs 10–25 asynchronous tuning trials, then trimming cuts pipeline cost without regression.
In production, normalized entropy improved 0.31% and online A/B metric improved 0.20%.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers, this demonstrates agentic loops manipulating high-dimensional, resource-constrained systems—closer to 'reality-code' optimization via autonomous AI, though it does not address simulation hypothesis directly.

translations.title_zh: 面向机群级排序模型的成本感知型智能体特征优化系统
translations.tldr_zh: 本文提出一种LLM智能体系统，在共享和单模型资源约束下自主提出假设并调优机群级排序模型的交叉特征选择，带来可衡量的生产指标提升。
takeaways_zh: LLM智能体可作为研究者/优化器，在组合特征空间中通过与确定性工具协作执行实验和验证。
通过混合重要性排序和跨任务帕累托前沿，可在QPS与管道成本预算下进行成本感知的特征选择。
LLM研究者智能体进行10–25次异步调优试验，随后修剪步骤在无回归情况下削减管道成本。
生产中归一化熵平均改善0.31%，在线A/B测试主要指标改善0.20%。
translations.implication_zh: 对实践哲学家而言，这展示了智能体循环操纵高维、资源约束系统的能力，更接近通过自主AI进行“现实代码”优化，尽管并未直接涉及模拟假说。

tldr_en: Fast-JEPA is a latent world model planning method that improves action-sequence search by directly predicting outcomes of complete candidates, achieving higher success with lower latency than recursive rollout.
takeaways_en: Fast-JEPA reaches 96.5% average success and 2.41x faster planning than INTACT across four continuous-control tasks.
It replaces recursive state rollout with direct outcome prediction for complete action sequences, decoupling success from planning latency.
Introduces DynaGoal benchmark for world-model planning under distribution shift, deadlines, and response delays.
Search-budget sweeps confirm the success-latency Pareto advantage holds across candidate counts and refinement depths.
Code is open source, enabling direct reuse and benchmarking.
implication_en: For a practitioner-philosopher, this shows how low-latency internal world models can make autonomous agents more capable under real-time constraints, though it remains a tool for agent design rather than evidence about the computability of base reality.

translations.title_zh: Fast-JEPA：推进潜在世界模型的成功-延迟前沿
translations.tldr_zh: Fast-JEPA 是一种潜在世界模型规划方法，通过直接预测完整候选动作序列的结果来改进动作序列搜索，相比递归 rollout 取得了更高成功率和更低延迟。
takeaways_zh: Fast-JEPA 在四个连续控制任务上达到 96.5% 平均成功率，规划速度比 INTACT 快 2.41 倍。
它用对完整动作序列的直接结果预测替代递归状态 rollout，将成功率与规划延迟解耦。
引入 DynaGoal 基准，评估分布偏移、截止时间和响应延迟下的世界模型规划。
搜索预算扫描证实其成功-延迟 Pareto 优势在不同候选数量和细化深度下均成立。
代码开源，便于直接复用和基准测试。
translations.implication_zh: 对于实践者-哲学家而言，这表明低延迟内部世界模型能让智能体在实时约束下更高效地规划，但仍是智能体设计工具，而非关于基础现实可计算性的证据。

tldr_en: Google DeepMind launches Project Genie powered by Genie 4, letting users create and explore real-time interactive AI-generated worlds with natural language control, dynamic physics, audio, dialogue, and an agent that builds worlds and suggests live events.
takeaways_en: Genie 4 enables real-time world generation and manipulation via natural language, including weather, characters, and action changes with simulated physics and scene-matched audio.
The Project Genie agent generates starting visuals and background music, while Gemini observes sessions to suggest or trigger live events.
Users can explore and remix community worlds, and experiment with upgraded Genie 3 capabilities like 3-minute sessions and 360-degree panorama grounding.
Access is rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers (18+), with Pro members able to join a waitlist.
implication_en: This operationalizes the creation of persistent, language-steerable simulated worlds with embedded agents, making the simulation hypothesis tangible and offering a practical sandbox for agent-world interaction.

translations.title_zh: 推出由 Genie 4 驱动的全新 Project Genie
translations.tldr_zh: Google DeepMind 推出由 Genie 4 驱动的 Project Genie，使用户能够通过自然语言实时创建和探索 AI 生成的交互式世界，包括动态物理、音频、角色对话，以及一个可构建世界并建议实时事件的智能体。
takeaways_zh: Genie 4 支持通过自然语言实时生成和操控世界，包括天气、角色和动作变化，并具有模拟物理和场景匹配音频。
Project Genie 智能体会生成初始视觉和背景音乐，Gemini 在会话中观察并建议或触发实时事件。
用户可以探索和混编社区世界，并体验升级版 Genie 3 功能，如最长 3 分钟会话和 360 度全景锚定。
该功能正在向 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户（18 岁以上）推出，Pro 会员可加入候补名单。
translations.implication_zh: 这将语言可操控、嵌入智能体的持久模拟世界变为可操作，使模拟假说变得可感知，并提供了智能体-世界交互的实用沙盒。
